hooks.name: Session brief
hooks.description: Starts every session informed: the latest property-test catches, open questions that block work, open human gates, and how much of the working tree is uncommitted. Reads files only; runs no tests.

action.command: echo 'Afterglow session brief'; echo 'Latest property-test catches:'; grep '^## ' docs/kiro/pbt-catches.md 2>/dev/null | tail -3 | sed 's/^## /  - /'; echo 'Open questions and human gates:'; grep -h -E '^## Open question|\[ \] \[H\]' .kiro/specs/*/requirements.md .kiro/specs/*/tasks.md 2>/dev/null | head -8 | sed 's/^/  - /'; echo "Uncommitted paths: $(git status --short 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"; exit 0
